name: A sale on the corner
prompt: From the cruiser you watch a hand-to-hand at the corner: cash one way, a small bag the other.

choices.text: Note the corner and the time for the detectives

outcome.told: You write it up. Someone downtown will read it, or won't.
The bag is in his jacket pocket with eleven more. You make the arrest and spend the rest of the shift on the paperwork.

failure.told: He drops it down a storm drain before you're out of the car. Nothing to charge, and a complaint about the stop.
